subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella before more retry or fallback patches land?
rationale: The bug is real, but the permanent fix changes at-least-once delivery, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, and duplicate-prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require a durable outbox or equivalent state machine before accepting partial retry changes.

options.title: Land a narrow retry PR first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 or a similar PR as an interim fix, with live proof and explicit follow-up issues for remaining races.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Move each remaining announce, yield, restart, and timeout failure to a narrower owner issue before closing this umbrella.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require a durable outbox or equivalent state machine before accepting partial retry changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core architecture and product semantics, and history shows steipete carried major subagent registry lifecycle/helper refactors.
